To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Ca2+,Mg2+-ATPases of the uterus smooth-muscle-cell plasma membrane are not inhibited by well-known inhibitors of the energy-dependent Ca2+,Mn2+-ATP-ases of the endo(sar)co-plasmic reticulums, the mitochondrial Ca2+,M2+-ATP-as and the Ca(2+),Na+-ATPase of plasma membranes.

the activity of the purified myometrium plasma membrane Ca( 2+), Mg(2+) -ATPase is sensitive only to the well-known inhibitors of the Ca(2+ )-pump activity of the endo(sarcom)plasmic and mitochondrial reticulum.
the activity of purified myometria cell plasma membrane Ca( 2+), Mg(2+), ATPase was inhibited by eosin Y and orthovanadate, but not by thapsigargin and ruthenium red.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility to use purified Ca2+,Mg2+ ATPase of uterus myometrium cell sarcolemma for estimation of the efficacy of inhibitors of energy-dependent transport systems of Ca(2+).
the development of a new method of the estimation of inhibitors efficacy of energy-dependent Ca-transporting systems.
the fact that the Ca(2+), Mg(2+)-(Na,K)-ATPase is a specific target for the inhibitors of the endo(sar)plasmic and mitochondrial Ca(2+)+-transporting ATPases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
eosin Y and vanadate are the most potent inhibitors of Ca(2+), Mg(2+)-(Na+)-ATPases in the uterus smooth muscle cells.
the plasma membrane Ca2+ pump is the only energy-dependent Ca(+) transporting system in the uterus smooth muscle cells.
the plasma membrane Ca2+ pump is not a target for the inhibitors of endo(sarcom)plasmic and mitochondrial calcium pumps.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
only eosin Y, o- and m-vanadates are effective inhibitors of the Ca(2+), Mg(2+), K(+)-ATPase from the myometrium smooth muscle cell plasma membranes.

only inhibitors of the endo(sarcom)plasmic Ca(2+), Mg(2+)(ATPase)-transporting systems can be used for comparative estimation of efficiency of inhibitors of the Ca2+,Mg2+-ATP-ase of the uterus myometrium cell sarcolemma.
the Ca(2+), Mg(2+), K(+)-ATPase activity of plasma membranes from smooth muscle cells is not inhibited by inhibitors of endo(sarcom)plasmic Ca(2+)(+)-transporting system or mitochondrial Ca(2+).
The main takeaway from our work is that
eosin Y and vanadate are effective inhibitors of the Ca(2+), Mg(2+), ATPase in the myometrium plasma membrane.
the Ca(2+), Mg(2+)(2)-ATPase from myometrial cell plasma membrane can be used as a model to study the mechanism of action of various inhibitors of energy-dependent calcium-transporting systems.
the plasma membrane Ca2+-transporting system of the uterus smooth myometrium cell is not sensitive to the inhibitors of the Ca2+-pumps of other cellular organelles.
